title: Springboks Bounce Back, South African Stars Launch in Europe & More: Betting Insights for Africa
flags: In a 43‑28 thriller, the Springboks edged out the All Blacks at Baltimore in the Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry series.
Mayambela hosted a Spanish club for his debut, while Mofokeng’s first match is yet to be announced.
Courtney Jameson of @DummySwitchPod admitted that Baltimore had felt “wrong” for hosting the Boks–All Blacks clash, until six tries and a 68,000‑strong crowd rewrote the story.
Former Governor Gbenga Daniel and former Governor Ibikunle Amosun are set to lead the Ogun APC campaign for 2027.
A Carwash podcast episode featuring Teko Modise, Linda Mntambo and Brighton Mhlongo raised concerns about whether the PSL system is unfair to clubs outside the “big 3.”
Kaizer Chiefs coach Fernando Da Cruz hinted that the club is still open to making moves as the deadline approaches.
Lyle Foster may miss the upcoming international break with Bafana Bafana.
Arsenal’s Max Dowman, who has been an unused substitute on four occasions, will finally get his chance in the team.
